nom: OSEA Marine Screen SPF 50 Mineral Sunscreen

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive or reactive consistently report no irritation and, notably, no breakouts — several contrasting this directly with other sunscreens that reliably broke them out in the past.
segments.combination: The couple of reviewers with combination skin, including one who calls her skin very sensitive and combination, report no breakouts and a non-greasy feel.
segments.mature: One reviewer, a 73-year-old with a history of skin cancer surgeries, reports good results working this sunscreen into a full OSEA routine, though this is the only reviewer to give clear age context.

concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers, including several who say they normally break out from sunscreen, report no breakouts with this one, including two who both have very sensitive skin; no reviewer in this set reports new breakouts caused by the product.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe the finish as non-greasy and lightweight rather than oily, including some contrasting it with other sunscreens that leave their skin feeling oily; a couple of reviewers, however, say it goes on oily or greasy at first, in one case pilling afterward.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the sunscreen as hydrating rather than drying, several noting it feels like a light moisturizer and one saying it hasn't dried out her skin the way past sunscreens did; no reviewer in this set reports dryness from the product.
concerns.redness: One reviewer, who is light-skinned with freckles and usually burns, reports no sunburn or redness after wearing it; no other reviewer discusses redness specifically.
concerns.aging: A few reviewers mention the sunscreen's hyaluronic acid or its role in preventing future sun-driven aging, but these read mainly as appreciation of the ingredient claims rather than a reported change in fine lines.

aspects.libelle: No white cast for most users
White cast possible on deeper or tan skin tones
Can pill when layered with other products

extraits.titre: BEWARE: Product pills & doesn't layer well
extraits.texte: This sunscreen is thick & moisturizing! However, it didn't layer well with other products (even after exfoliating). It clumped & pilled around my eyes, hairline, & neck. It left a white cast on my eyelids & smile lines. Not for melanated skin!

So far, I'm liking the sunscreen texture; however, I notice a distinct unpleasant smell as soon as I step outdoors. At first, I thought it was air pollution, but after a couple of days, I realized it was the new sunscreen. It's honestly made me more hesitant to wear it daily, since the smell is so distractingly unpleasant when I'm in the sun.

Great SPF- I have sensitive skin and this lotion doesn't irritate my skin at all. Smooth and moisturizing without being heavy or greasy. *One drawback = My friend who has a darker skin tone than me did get a white cast that wouldn't blend in.

After recently buying my wife a gift of Osea products that she loved, and then reading Osea's recommendation on how to take care of my own skin, as a 73-year old male I decided on my first skincare protocol as an experiment: Ocean Cleanser, then Sea Minerals Mist, then Advanced Protection Cream, then Marine Screen SPF 50 Mineral Sunscreen. My wife so loved my "new" face, she's now using my protocol (which of course is your protocol). We're having some fun at our house with Osea these days!! Thank you for the excellent products. I'm a busy psychotherapist, and a few clients have recently entered my office and said, "let's see, am I noticing something different about you?" Pretty funny! P.S. I've had 8 MOHS surgeries on my face since 2008, so I should have been doing this a long time ago! "Better late than never."

As someone with sensitive skin, Ive always broken out after using sunscreen but Ive used the marine screen a few times now and I am so pleased that I havent experienced any breakouts! Its light weight and doesnt sit heavy on my face. It also doesnt leave the white residue on your face like some sunscreens are prone to do! Ive also found that it is pretty hydrating and hasnt dried out my skin after use like Ive experienced in the past with out sunscreens. Really pleased with this!

extraits.titre: Possibly the best Osea Product yet!
extraits.texte: I've been hoping for the day Osea made a sunscreen and it's finally here!! Ive spent a good amount of money try to find a mineral sunscreen that works for my very sensitive combination skin. I absolutely LOVE this sunscreen and would recommend it to anyone! It soaks in fast and leaves a very smoothing finish on the skin- non white casting, non greasy and a very light scent that goes away fast. The ONLY thing that would make this product better is if they had a tinted option!

I love this sunscreen. Its easy to apply and sinks into my skin without leaving any white marks. I used it while on holiday in San Diego. Im not a lover of sunscreen but this product is easy to use and reapply throughout the day. It didnt feel like it was thick after the second reapply and I did not get a sun burn or any redness on my face which is rare for me as I am light skinned with freckles. Its definitely my new go to sunscreen
